messages.text: ERCOT issued a Watch (Thursday, January 09, 2025 and Friday, January 10, 2025 due to the possibility of Freezing precipitation...).

messages.content: I’ll build the day-ahead book with the cold-weather notices in mind, then revisit energy dispatch at each watch while keeping the ancillary-service awards fixed.

The battery is at 10 MWh at noon. Hour 8’s expected RegDn charging did not occur, and the controller charged in hour 9 to restore reserve backing, incurring a $20.40 failure charge. I’ll adjust the afternoon charging plan to back the remaining awards and reach the end-of-day SoC target.
